newsitems.title: 《矩阵：零日危机》2月5日维护更新公告
newsitems.author: 矩阵零日危机
newsitems.contents: [p][b]亲爱的矩阵英雄们[/b]：[/p][p][/p][p align="justify"]《矩阵：零日危机》服务器将于北京时间2026年2月5日10:00（UTC+8）完成停服更新维护，感谢大家的持续支持！[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][h3][b]【玩法内容更新】[/b][/h3][p align="justify"][b]「新赛季」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●本次维护后，S2「星海律动」赛季结束，开启S3新赛季「灵珑迎春」[/p][p align="justify"]●开放新活动-矩阵迎春，玩家完成每天任务收集积分，推动全服进度，领取专属奖励[/p][p align="justify"]●开放赛季专属饰品掉落：修正行动模式中有概率掉落赛季专属饰品，包括专属橙色脚印[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「往期赛季重置规则」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●永恒空间功能调整：永恒空间中装备系统替代战斗矩阵系统，战斗矩阵系统下线，往届赛季拥有战斗矩阵的玩家将会获得一个特殊头像作为纪念[/p][p align="justify"]●赛季重置内容：所有的赛季玩法模式进度及数据均会重置[/p][p align="justify"]●赛季保留内容：角色及外观、熟练度、能力模块、成就以及帝谷币等内容[/p][p align="justify"]●赛季转移入永恒空间的内容（临时仓库）：装备、核芯[/p][p align="justify"]●赛季不保留内容：矩阵币、晶核、核芯碎片、抑制代码、初级定位器、高级定位器、装备商城兑换道具（黯淡装备碎片）、帝谷密令[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「新模式-无序深渊」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●新赛季S3新增全新模式，引入局内随机事件与规则组合[/p][p align="justify"]●在波次间交互选择怪物强化Buff，通过主动提升挑战压力来换取成倍增长的掉落收益[/p][p align="justify"]●局内击杀怪物获取的特殊货币，可用于在关底“深渊商店”兑换随机高品质装备，让风险与惊喜并存[/p][p align="justify"]●配合5档自定义难度方案与优化后的十波次战斗节奏，更具深度与新鲜感的生存极限挑战现已全面开启！[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「新玩法-超能链接」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●新赛季S3限时开启，通关探索模式2-16后解锁，S3赛季结束后关闭[/p][p align="justify"]●击败敌人获取超能能量，消耗超能能量可以释放超能技[/p][p align="justify"]●组队时，任意队友释放超能技后激活链接时间，在链接时间内释放超能技或链接时间结束后将生成数据锁定笼罩全场。链接时间内释放超能技的队友越多，数据锁定效果越强。如果3人完成超能链接，将视为完美链接，数据锁定获得高额效果加成[/p][p align="justify"]●穿戴装备中某位法则的权限数量≥3后激活权限超能技，权限超能技最多同时激活1个（优先激活最多同类型法则的权限）[/p][p align="justify"]●激活权限超能技的权限词条≥6时，法则超能技等级+1，≥9时，权限超能技等级+2，此权限词条数量越多，局内获取超能能量的效率越高[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「角色」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●开放新角色「灵珑」，来自神秘世界的剑仙，操控飞剑，入地飞天，弹指间隐隐有龙吟之声[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「S3赛季全新外观」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●不朽级外观：瑶光仙裳（曙光）[/p][p align="justify"]●辉耀传说级外观：绯角甜心（曙光）、暗玫荆棘（叛音）[/p][p][/p][p][b]「装备系统新增&调整」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●新增打造材料-转换编译器：与转换晶核一起使用，可以为装备增加指定类型的副属性[/p][p align="justify"]●新增打造材料-重构编译器：与拓展数据一起使用，可以为装备新增指定类型的副属性[/p][p align="justify"]●新增打造材料-铸印晶核：可以为首饰类装备增加一条机制型词条[/p][p align="justify"]●新增打造材料-铸印编译器：与铸印晶核一起使用，可以为增加全新类型的机制型词条[/p][p align="justify"]●装备-潜能芯片锁定，潜能升级到赛季能力中获取和装备，详见“赛季能力系统“[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「全新系统-赛季能力系统」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●赛季能力分为属性节点和可镶嵌节点，属性节点点亮即生效，可镶嵌节点需要镶嵌后生效[/p][p align="justify"]●可镶嵌节点分为通用节点和英雄专属节点，通用节点所有英雄通用不需要重复点亮，英雄专属节点每个英雄需要分别点亮[/p][p align="justify"]●消耗材料“祝福符印”可点亮节点，每次点亮都会随机三个未点亮的节点可供点亮；祝福符印可通过战斗获得[/p][p align="justify"]●镶嵌节点需要消耗对应颜色的符印，符印的上限及种类可以通过对镶嵌位的升阶和洗练获得[/p][p align="justify"]●所有可镶嵌节点的属性都对应着不同的能力，通过镶嵌节点可以搭配出丰富的能力组合[/p][p align="justify"]●福缘进境中可以消耗行动积分升级基础属性能力，每天修正行动中收获行动积分后，局可以来提升能力[/p][p align="justify"]●“祝福符印”以及洗练和升阶材料“迎春灯笼”和“锦鲤绘卷”均可通过修正行动和探索模式等战斗获得[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「修正行动优化」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●修正回响玩法：挑战前可以选择装备修正定位器（非必选），修正定位器的基础属性为提升掉落，随机属性为改变关卡相关属性的词条，修正定位器为消耗品[/p][p align="justify"]●修正定位器打造：可以花费材料对修正定位器进行打造提升掉落属性，但同时会增加随机属性条数，支持重置[/p][p align="justify"]●链路重构：可以对修正行动的各种小玩法进行培养，提升其产出效率和掉落品质等，培养的材料通过对应的小玩法获得[/p][p align="justify"]●修正回响中的道具和材料均可通过修正行动获取[/p][p align="justify"]●故障清单功能下线[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「失序链区优化」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●增加困难难度BOSS-麦克斯·新春炸弹、征服者·三重攻势[/p][p align="justify"]●下架困难BOSS无相、联动Boss第六使徒及使徒定位器[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「怪物」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●优化升级精英怪物-格里弗斯[/p][p align="justify"]●新增怪物词条-新春爆竹[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"][b]「其他调整」[/b][/p][p align="justify"]●下线模式-病毒狂潮[/p][p align="justify"]●修复了部分已知的BUG[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p align="justify"]矩阵因你而生动，新春因你而温暖。期待各位英雄在新赛季中执剑破局，共赴新生！[/p][p align="justify"]如在游戏过程中遇到任何问题，欢迎通过游戏内客服系统或官方社群进行反馈。[/p][p align="justify"] [/p][p]《矩阵：零日危机》运营团队[/p]

newsitems.title: Server Maintenance Update Notice
newsitems.author: lynnchao
newsitems.contents: [p]Dear Rogueteers,[/p][p] [/p][p]Terminull Brigade will be down for server maintenance starting from Dec 18, 2025 at 15:00 (UTC+8). Server maintenance is projected to last for 4 hours. During this period, Rogueteers will not be able to access the game.[/p][p]If the server maintenance is not concluded within this period, it will be extended. We ask for all Rogueteers' understanding.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Gameplay Updates][/p][p]Gameplay[/p][p]● Increased the Advanced Locator drop rate in Corrective Action and in the final chapter of Exploration Mode.[/p][p]● Increased the drop rates of all items in Protostar (Finale).[/p][p]● Reduced the skill damage multiplier for certain elites in Protostar stages.[/p][p]● Reduced the difficulty of enemy lineups in Corrective Action in Protostar stages.[/p][p]Upgrade Systems[/p][p]● Optimized Chaos, Collapse, Disintegration, Anomaly, and other attribute-related descriptions.[/p][p]\[Store Updates][/p][p]● The new Immortal-tier skins Rei: Eternal Vow (Yuri) and Asuka: Devoted Pledge (Diana) can be obtained through the Terminull Pact Data Vault.[/p][p]● New Crystal Core Packs, Pulse Core Packs, Refactor Core Packs, and Conversion Core Packs are now available in the Store.[/p][p]\[Bug Fixes][/p][p]Equipment Systems[/p][p]● Hailstorms triggered by the equipment Perk Trait Hoarfrost Verdict now properly deal damage.[/p][p]● While using Yuri in combat, aiming down sights and then checking equipment names no longer causes drift.[/p][p]● Cores now correctly display lowered attributes after a Data Refactoring failure.[/p][p]● Entering the Core Upgrade menu during recruitment no longer triggers a bug.[/p][p]● Expansion Data is now properly grayed out once equipment sub-attributes are maxed out. This was a purely display-related issue that did not actually consume Expansion Data.[/p][p]● Switching from the Equipment to Refactor interface no longer causes the game to freeze.[/p][p]Rogueteers[/p][p]● Blade's Invulnerability now expires properly when she uses Heartfelt's Weapon Skill.[/p][p]● Changes to Dark Hunt's weapon skin color now properly takes effect.[/p][p]● Yuri's skill, Holo-Sight, now properly triggers damage numbers when attacking Conqueror Slimes.[/p][p]● Yuri's Disable Weapon Skills trait no longer disables the enhanced shot of her skill Holo-Sight.[/p][p]● While stealthed, Yuri can no longer bypass Jory's Invulnerability with multi-hit attacks.[/p][p]● Magazine and attack speed effects now properly apply to Max’s weapon, One Shot to Flatten 'Em All.[/p][p]Gameplay[/p][p]● Item drop previews in Viral Frenzy now correctly display Expansion Cores rather than Pulse Cores.[/p][p]Enemies[/p][p]● Virus Core no longer freezes when entering Phase 2.[/p][p]Other Issues[/p][p]● Fixed damage loss in certain combat situations.[/p][p]● Arbiters can now be rerolled with the default Z key.[/p][p]● Fixed errors in the Battle History display in the Career interface.[/p][p]● Fixed incorrect descriptions when claiming item rewards in the Life in the Terminull event.[/p][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Season 2 Launch Patch Notes — Rebirth: Code Invasion
newsitems.author: lynnchao
newsitems.contents:
[p]Dear Rogueteers,[/p][p]The servers of Terminull Brigade will be temporarily shut down for maintenance on December 3rd, 2025, from 02:00 (EST) until 06:00 (EST), during which Rogueteers will not be able to access the game. If the server maintenance is not concluded within this period, it will be extended. We ask for all Rogueteers' understanding. Thank you all for your continued support![/p][h2][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45327692/a764b8a32b3827e6f5f63b88dc133e5e27e83842.jpg"][/img][/h2][hr][/hr][h2]\[Gameplay Updates][/h2][h3]New Season[/h3][list][*][p]After this maintenance, S1 "Stellar Rhythm" will end, and S2 "Rebirth: Code Invasion" will begin.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Season Reset Information[/h3][list][*][p]The Ever-verse will unlock the Combat Terminull's temporary Warehouse, where S1 Modules and Cores will be stored. You can take out Modules that you'd like to keep and deposit them in the Ever-verse's Terminull Warehouse, but cannot deposit them back in the temporary Warehouse. The temporary Warehouse will be closed at the end of S2.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]To be reset: All seasonal gameplay progress and data will be reset.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Items that will carry over to the next season: Unlocked Rogueteers and Skins, Proficiency, Ability Modules, Achievements, Decoders, Pass Points, and Store Coins (Platinum Coin, Tycho Coin, Purified Data).[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Items that will be transferred to the Ever-verse's temporary Warehouse: Modules and Cores.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Items that will be removed: Terminull Coins, Crystal Cores, Core Fragments, Expanse Beacons, Basic Locators, Advanced Locators, and Module Store Redemption Items (Faded Modules).[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gameplay[/h3][list][*][p]New Exploration Mode will be available. In this remade Main Story, follow Aion's guidance to uncover Terminull's secrets step by step.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The original Standard Mode will be changed to Classic Mode, which keeps the original gameplay, but equipment stats will not take effect in this mode.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Perk and Key of Potential selection will be removed from all modes except Classic Mode.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrective Action's objective will be adjusted to defeat enough enemies to earn progress. At 100% progress, Rogueteers will be able to challenge the boss.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Corrective Action's Chaos effects can be customized. Rogueteers will be able to spend Breakdown Points to select different Chaos effects for their builds.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The "Chromatic Treasure Cat" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Defeating Treasure Cats of different colors will drop different rewards.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mystery Crates will be added to Corrective Action. Mystery Crates will have a chance to spawn during battle and will grant rewards when looted.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]An Easter Egg stage, Wonderland, will be added to Corrective Action as an extra challenge. Successful completion will grant rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Viral Nest" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Viral Nests will have a chance to spawn during battle. Destroying them all will grant rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]The "Mystery Trap" gameplay will be added to Corrective Action. Stepping into a trap will summon random monsters but will also grant a random buff.[/p][/*][*][p]A double boss challenge involving Blade and the Punisher will be added to Corrective Action.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Floors 51-70 will be added to Corrective Action, with significantly increased difficulty and rewards.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]A new boss, Virus Core, will be added to Chains of Disorder.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Viral Frenzy Mode will return with new events and mechanics.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Endless Expanse Mode will be taken offline.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images//45327692/914bc3b00fa1a91b46e71320ea7c91244f07666c.jpg"][/img]
[/p][h3]Rogueteers[/h3][list][*][p]A new Rogueteer, Diana, will go live: A competitive and powerful bounty hunter who fights with a spear and assault rifle. She is a versatile all-rounder capable of both offense and defense.[/p][/*][*][p]A new Rogueteer, Yuri, will go live: A calm and decisive ace sniper powerful enough to tear through space.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Gloria's new weapon, Spirit Witch's Healing, will be available.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Colonel's new weapon, Adjudicator, will be available.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Upgrade Systems[/h3][list][*][p]The Equipment system will be launched, unlocking 11 equippable slots.[/p][/*][*][p]The original Arbiter Perks and Keys of Potential will now serve as Equipment Traits. Rare or higher-quality equipment will be guaranteed to carry 1-2 Perk Traits, allowing Rogueteers to create different Perk builds with equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]The equipment category, Chip, will be available. Weapon Chips, Skill Chips, and Speed Chips will have Arbiter active Perks and corresponding enhancement Traits. Potential Chips will be guaranteed to carry Key of Potential Traits.[/p][/*][*][p]The equipment category, Armor, will be available, including Head, Torso, Waist, and Leg Armor. They will have Arbiter Passive Perk Trait and various mechanic Traits (formerly Module Traits from the Combat Terminull). Immortal Armor will have Rogueteer-exclusive Traits.[/p][/*][*][p]The equipment category, Ornament, will be available, including Rings, Bracelets, and Necklaces. They will have Arbiter Passive Perk Traits or Duo Perks Traits.[/p][/*][*][p]All Module Traits (including Rogueteer Traits) from the previous season's Combat Terminull will be available from equipment.[/p][/*][*][p]New attributes, Special Attack and Special Resistance, will be added, which will increase Special Attack bonuses and resistance to Special Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]A new Arbiter, Wasteland, will be available: As the dominant Arbiter of the Wasteland, it specializes in chained bursts and stacking damage amplification. Acquire its Perk Traits from Equipment Traits.[/p][/*][*][p]The Combat Terminull and Season Talents will be temporarily taken offline.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Enemy Traits that benefit Rogueteers will be added. After defeating certain enemies, Rogueteers will be able to pick up dropped buffs such as AoE Time Stop, AoE Black Hole, and Elemental Orbs.[/p][/*][*][p]The AI and skill combinations for Cyber Ranged Elites, Geomancer Elites, and Reaper Elites will be optimized and upgraded. Combat scenarios featuring a mix of elites will be added.[/p][/*][*][p]Standard enemy AI will be optimized to improve the overall in-match combat experience.[/p][/*][/list][h3]「Exchange Store」[/h3][list][*][p]Materials from disassembled equipment will be standardized to Faded Equipment Shards.[/p][/*][*][p]The Module Store will be changed to the Equipment Store, with Intensity IV or above Arbiter Chip Equipment added.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Appendix[/h2][h3]New Equipment Traits[/h3][h3]Blade[/h3][list][*][p]Oblivion's Pact: Blade's weapon damage cannot CRIT. All weapon CRIT damage beyond 100% is instead converted into Weapon Power at 3× efficiency, up to a maximum of 3200%.[/p][/*][*][p]Doom's Surge: After Blade maxes out the Arbiter of Energy's Power Surge stacks, weapon damage charges up Supernova Burst, triggered at most once every 0.5s. Each Power Surge stack increases Supernova Burst damage by 15%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Aurora[/h3][list][*][p]Barrage Suppression: Reduce Aurora's rate of fire by 0.5× but increase her projectile count by 2.[/p][/*][*][p]Thunder Meister: While Aurora's Minor is active, increase all Arbiter of Thunder damage by 300%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Colonel[/h3][list][*][p]Annihilation Protocol: After Colonel activates a skill, increase weapon CRIT damage by 1.5×. This effect can stack if triggered by different skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Overload Focus: Colonel's skills builds Power Surge strikes twice as fast. Increase Power Surge strike damage by 300%.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Max[/h3][list][*][p]Rocket Blastwave: When Max's rockets deal damage, trigger an additional ranged effect that deals weapon damage, at most once every 0.1s.[/p][/*][*][p]Explosive Symphony: Each time Max inflicts Repulsion damage from the Arbiter of Music, increase Repulsion damage by 1%, up to 300 stacks.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Heynckes[/h3][list][*][p]Source Convergence: Increase Heynckes' weapon damage bonus by 50% of his skill damage bonus, 25% of his Primary damage bonus, 50% of his Minor damage bonus, and 15% of his Ultimate damage bonus.[/p][/*][*][p]Overlimit Liberation: After Heynckes lands a CRIT, increase weapon CRIT damage by 1.3× and skill CRIT damage by 1.3× for 5s, up to 5 stacks.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Gloria[/h3][list][*][p]Flash of Insight: When Gloria lands a weapon CRIT, all Turrets' subsequent attack additionally deal 100% of this instance of damage as true damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Critical Chain: When Gloria's skills CRIT, Turrets attack 1 additional time, triggered at most once every 2s.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Rebela[/h3][list][*][p]Sonic Frenzy: At or above 80 Revelry, Rebela's triggered Sound Waves have a 5% chance to be treated as weapon damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Twin Rhythm: At or above 50 Revelry, double Rebela's Arbiter of Music damage.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Yuri[/h3][list][*][p]Holo-Engraving: If Yuri has aimed down sights at an enemy for over 2s, immediately triggers one upgraded Holo-Sight attack, at most once every 5s. Closing the scope cancels the upgraded attack but does not refund its cooldown.[/p][/*][*][p]Afterimage Sniping: While Yuri's Minor is active, create 1 clone every second. The clone casts Primary alongside Yuri, then disappears thereafter.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Diana[/h3][list][*][p]Ready to Strike: Each stack of Endurance increases Diana's final damage by 15%.[/p][/*][*][p]Endless Hunt: Increase Diana's Primary damage by 3×. Potential Chip: Hunting Penetration can strike the same enemy repeatedly, up to 10 times.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

newsitems.title: Server Update Notice (Oct 20, 2025)
newsitems.author: lynnchao
newsitems.contents: [h1]Dear Rogueteers,[/h1][p]In order to enhance your gaming experience, we have completed a server update on October 20, 20:00 (UTC+8). Thank you for your continued support![/p][hr][/hr][p]\[Updated Contents][/p][p]Increased all drop rates until the end of the current season.[/p][p]● Increased the Immortal Module drop rate in Chains of Disorder by 100%, and the First-Tune and Final-Tune Crystal Core drop rate by 200%.[/p][p]● Increased the Reshape Crystal Core, Exchange Crystal Core, Reset Crystal Core, and Refactor Data drop rate by 100%, and the Space Bunny, Support Ears, and Sonata drop rate by 100%.[/p][hr][/hr][p]\[Fixed Issues][/p][p]● Combat Terminull[/p][p]1. Fixed a display issue in the Combat Terminull in which the same type of Module could be added beyond the stated capacity (although Modules beyond the capacity would not actually take effect).[/p][p]2. newsitems.title: Join Terminull Brigade's Alpha Test
newsitems.author: JetBlade
newsitems.contents:
Hey Rogueteers!

We’re thrilled to finally share something we’ve been cooking up in the Unreal Engine kitchen for over two years—Terminull Brigade is almost ready for you!

Terminull Brigade is a fast-paced, co-op action-roguelike hero-shooter still in its early stages of development, and we couldn’t be more excited for you to check it out. 

[h3][b]Why a Shooter-Roguelike hybrid?[/b][/h3]

[b]Passion[/b]
We blend shooter and roguelike elements out of genuine passion. As fans of both genres, we’re driven by:
[list]
[*] The high-energy and nonstop action of shooters.
[*] The endless depth and replayability of roguelikes.
[*] This combination enhances the strengths of both, promising a uniquely thrilling experience.
[/list]
[b]Expertise[/b]
With over a decade of shooter development experience and a strong grasp of roguelike mechanics, our team is primed to deliver something special.  We’re confident that Terminull Brigade will exceed the expectations of both shooter and roguelike fans.


[h3][b]Why co-op gameplay?[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Explore Together[/b]: Dive into the NullVerse with friends, facing exciting challenges together.
[*] [b]Dynamic Character & Skills[/b]: Combine character builds and unique skills to boost team performance.
[*] [b]Item Swaping[/b]: Swap items with teammates to optimize strategies.
[*] [b]Enhanced Roguelike Randomness[/b]: Enjoy the unpredictable thrill of roguelike gameplay, made even more exciting by teamwork.
[/list]
------
Perhaps you took part in our early closed pre-alpha back in October, when we were using the code name Project Rogueteers (sound familiar?)

But if you missed out, don’t worry! We’ve got you covered. 
We’re hosting a brand-new Alpha playtest from December 16th to 20th, and we’d love for you to jump in!

Click on the link below and fill out the quick sign-up form to secure your spot in the Alpha playtest: 

[h1][b][url=https://www.terminullbrigade.com/signup.html]Alpha sign-up[/url][/b][/h1]

Can’t wait to see you in the Nullverse, Rogueteer!

[b]P.S[/b]
Don't forget to wishlist & join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/jXVNZW6E6f]Discord community[/url]! 

We'll keep you updated on our progress as we work together to create a better Terminull Brigade for everyone!

Cheers,
The Pew Pew Games Team
